newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - GILTS TO FIND BASE AT 113-30/113-22.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - GILTS TO FIND BASE AT 113-30/113-22.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE are likely to find support a little way below Friday's close after selling off on the back of T-bonds on Friday, technical analysts said on Monday.
"If gilts had not been hampered by the T-bond sell-off, they would have done pretty well last week," said David Wood, independent technical analyst near London.
"As it is, the T-bond will bring gilts down to a very powerful support area at 113-30/113-22."
This support band reflects a heavy amount of price action over some time, Wood added.
September gilts closed at 114-09 on Friday, and opened at 114-04 on Monday. There were back at 114-09 at 0707 GMT.

"The lower top pattern that was needed to call the market significantly lower formed on Friday after the drop away from Thursday's high at 115-19," said Juliette Clark, senior treasury manager at Royal Bank of Scotland, in a note to clients.
"All that is required today to complete the bear signal is a break of Friday's late low at 113-28," she added.
The 113-28 level is also a 50 percent retracement of the rally on continuation charts from the 111-21 low on May 22 to the 116-02 high on July 30 and 31.
"A slight bounce will follow to 114-09 if early activity is sustained above 113-28," Clark said.

Wood found an initial band of resistance at 114-11/114-14. Beyond that, 114-21 was key, he said. "That's the main swing resistance on hourly charts. A break through there would confirm the 113-22/113-30 base."

If that support gives way, the next prop is a full point lower, at 112-25, Wood said. "If there is a continued sell-off in T-bonds, gilts will follow through dramatically. But I do not see a further sell-off as that likely."
December short sterling was unchanged at 92.67.
